what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Chad in the Central African Republic: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7886 Chadian asylum seekers in the Central African Republic, 46.1% of all asylum seekers from Chad.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Chad in periods from 1997 to 2023, most recently with CCMSR and FACT.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Chad in 2015 and from 2017 to 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 191 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 32171, at the end of 2023, the main year of displacement in the data, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Central African Republic.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the Central African Republic only.
